## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Gotamabuddhavaṁsa* ("The History of the Buddha Gotama") constitutes the twenty-seventh chapter of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, situated within the late strata of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral]. The reference literature corpus provided no specific analytical discussion of this chapter, as the sole candidate passage proved to be a false match resulting from a footnote index attached to the general title of the *Buddhavaṁsa*.
According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive Pali-internal text reuse, sharing 191 matching passages across 19 other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial textual correspondence is found in its commentary, the *Buddhavaṁsa-aṭṭhakathā* (63 matches, with segments §13.1–22.6 aligned with high similarity), as well as foundational commentarial narratives including the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā* (each sharing segments §8.1–9.2) [DharmaNexus]. It also regularly shares formulaic biographical descriptions with other chapters of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, particularly the *Dīpaṅkarabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 3), *Vipassībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 21), *Sikhībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 22), and *Kassapabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 26) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus identifies passages matching sections of the Tibetan *Jātakanidāna* (D0032, aligning around §8.1–8.2) and the Tibetan *Bhadrakalpikasūtra* (*ārya-bhadrakalpikā-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra*, D0094) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
